ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Бог» (bog, 'God'), printed lowercase in this edition, is capitalized in English, and pronouns for God follow the lowercase Russian ('him'); «сознание» (soznanie, 'consciousness') and «познание» (poznanie, 'knowledge') are kept distinct as in the opening thought. The paragraph beginning 'A select minority' stands after the Rousseau attribution and outside the quotation, as printed; «Д' Эшерни» is 'D'Escherny', not the website draft's 'D'Acherny'.

Source observation: [7] The unquoted paragraph «Избранное меньшинство…» (izbrannoe men'shinstvo, 'a select minority') follows the Rousseau attribution yet reads as a continuation of Rousseau's first-person argument; the attribution may be misplaced or the quote markup lost. Translated as printed (unquoted, after the attribution).
